headline: MAK Capital Increases Stake in Hapvida to 5.05%
summary: Hapvida received notification that U.S. asset manager MAK Capital Fund LP increased its stake to approximately 5.05% of the health insurer's common shares.
why: Hapvida is a major Brazilian health insurance and healthcare provider, making shifts in institutional shareholdings relevant for corporate governance and market valuation.

impacts.name: Hapvida
impacts.why: Increased institutional investment can signal external confidence in the company's valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
